transcript: Summer AC tune-up call for Brian O'Connor over on 552 Clearwater Drive. Performed full AC tune-up service. The outside condenser fan was humming but not starting. Replaced the swollen dual run capacitor with a forty-five by five microfarad unit. Added two and a half pounds of R-410A refrigerant to get the subcooling into spec. Took one hour labor. All those items are in the price book.

expected.job_summary: AC tune-up, capacitor replacement, and refrigerant recharge
